create_Trajectory: create an empty Trajectory with given observation and action shapes using Trajectory.create_empty
segment_observations: segment raw observations into padded trajectories using the segment function with terminal flags
build_SequenceDataset: build a SequenceDataset from a D4RL dataset with configurable sequence length and discount factor
evaluate_policy: evaluate a behavior cloning policy over multiple episodes using the evaluate function with a sample action callable
create_OfflineReplayBuffer: create an OfflineReplayBuffer iterable dataset from a replay directory with configurable sampling mode and trajectory length
